fichas.title: Conversion of an Office Block into Flats
fichas.summary: An office block built in 1965 is shown in its as-built configuration and converted into flats, with an alternative office-use layout also illustrated. The text stresses checking the structural system before design work and considering building-physics requirements when estimating refurbishment costs.

fichas.summary: A former warehouse is converted into a residential and office building. The illustrated proposal shows a new façade design, demonstrating the adaptation of an existing building to new uses.

fichas.title: Structural and Building-Physics Considerations for Concrete Conversions
fichas.summary: For older office and industrial buildings, assessment of the structural system is a key basis for deciding whether continued use is suitable. The text recommends involving an experienced engineer before design work and consulting building archives, historic regulations, and site investigations. Refurbishment may also need to address fire-protection-related concrete covering and stricter thermal-insulation requirements.
fichas.building_type: Existing reinforced-concrete office or industrial building
